function.name: runts
function.description: Run a JavaScript or TypeScript snippet with bun inside your workplace and return {stdout, stderr, exit_code, execution_time}. Use this instead of bash for multi-line JS/TS: no heredocs, no shell quote escaping. The snippet runs with the workplace root as its working directory, so imports resolve against the project's own node_modules (e.g. `import { z } from "zod"` picks up the project's copy). TypeScript runs natively — types are stripped, nothing is compiled to disk. STATELESS: every call is a fresh `bun -e` process. Variables, module state and timers do not persist between calls, unlike runpy. To keep a result, write a file into the workspace (e.g. await Bun.write("out.json", text)) and read it in a later call. Requires a sandboxed or workplace-backed execution environment: without one it refuses to run rather than executing on the Evonic host. Network and filesystem access are whatever the workplace allows.

code.description: JavaScript or TypeScript source to execute. Top-level await is supported. Use console.log for output.
